content.short: Semantic is an agentic payment stack for AI agents settling payments onchain.
content.description: Semantic builds a payment stack for AI agents, handling how autonomous systems authorise and settle payments on-chain. Stable's official documentation lists it among the x402 facilitators, which verify signed payments and submit the on-chain call that settles them in USDT0. Machine-to-machine payment is one of the use cases Stable was designed around.
